t: The Energy Detector can detect energy flow and acts as a resistor. You can define the max flow rate to use it as a resistor.$(p)For the full documentation please see the $(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/energy_detector/)official wiki page$(/l)$()!
能量侦测器可用于检测能量流，并可充当电阻器。你可以设定最大流速，从而将其用作电阻器。$(p)完整说明请参阅$(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/energy_detector/)官方维基页面$(/l)$()！
Connect your Energy Detector to a computer to make use of it!
将你的能量侦测器连接至计算机即可使用！
